dynamic_registry.lookup: linear on the cold name-to-ID path

security.policy_classification_owner: capability service and user-space policy libraries

remaining_product_coupling: User-folder capability variants and their path mapping remain in mnu.
SettingsRead and SettingsWrite remain tied to the shared-configuration path exception.
Service and Driver launch roles are still interpreted by the kernel policy module.
The panic report text still contains the mnu GitHub project URL.
notes: Unknown but syntactically valid product capabilities are interned once and stored as numeric IDs in process capability sets.
Only the kernel or a process holding capabilities.manage may create dynamic capability IDs during exec. Other callers can only reference existing IDs.
The registry stores each dynamic name once. A BTreeMap prototype was rejected because this cold path did not justify its code size and heap nodes.
The QEMU run reached the same existing display.driver status-1 exit seen before this change. The full smoke gate therefore remains unproven.
This commit is an intermediate boundary improvement, not proof that mnu is fully independent from mochiOS policy.
